title: Forge 12: Scaled dot-product and multi-head attention

wrong.no_scale.py: no 1/sqrt(d): scores grow with the head size, so softmax saturates and attention turns near one-hot
wrong.scale_by_d.py: divides by d instead of sqrt(d): over-corrects, attention becomes too flat
wrong.softmax_over_queries.py: normalises down the columns (axis -2) so each key's weights sum to 1 instead of each query's
wrong.mask_after_softmax.py: zeroes forbidden weights after the softmax without renormalising, so rows no longer sum to 1 and the future still steals probability mass
wrong.mask_fill_zero.py: masked scores are set to 0 instead of -inf, so forbidden keys still get e^0 weight
wrong.fully_masked_nan.py: a row with nothing allowed gives NaN (-inf minus -inf) instead of zeros
wrong.softmax_unstable.py: no max-subtraction: exp overflows for scores around 1000 and the result is NaN
wrong.causal_strict.py: mask excludes the diagonal (k < q), so a token cannot see itself and row 0 is fully masked
wrong.causal_flipped.py: upper-triangular mask: every token sees the FUTURE and nothing before it
wrong.backward_ignores_softmax.py: treats softmax as the identity in the backward pass (dS = dA)
wrong.backward_drops_row_term.py: softmax backward uses A * dA and forgets the -A * sum(dA * A) term (only the diagonal of the Jacobian)
wrong.backward_missing_scale.py: backward forgets the 1/sqrt(d) chain-rule factor from the forward scaling
wrong.backward_dq_dk_swapped.py: dQ and dK are swapped (dQ = dS^T Q, dK = dS K)
wrong.backward_dv_not_transposed.py: dV = A dout instead of A^T dout: wrong whenever attention is not symmetric
wrong.mha_heads_reshape_without_transpose.py: splits heads with a bare reshape to (N, h, T, d_head): time and feature axes get mixed instead of giving each head a contiguous block of features
wrong.mha_no_output_projection.py: skips the output projection Wo, so heads are only concatenated, never mixed
wrong.mha_scale_by_model_dim.py: each head scales by sqrt(d_model) instead of sqrt(d_head)
wrong.mha_dx_only_from_q.py: dx only sums the query path; the key and value paths into x are dropped
wrong.mha_causal_flag_ignored.py: always applies the causal mask, even when causal=False is requested
wrong.mha_accumulating_grads.py: weight gradients accumulate (+=) across backward calls instead of being set
wrong.mha_shared_init_matrix.py: Wq, Wk, Wv are the same matrix (one draw reused), so queries, keys and values are identical projections
wrong.mha_no_divisibility_check.py: does not reject d_model not divisible by n_heads; the reshape fails later with an obscure error or silently misbehaves

hints: Start with masked_softmax. Subtract the row max before exp (a score of 1000 overflows otherwise), put -inf where the mask forbids, and give a row with nothing allowed zeros: guard the max and the denominator so you never compute -inf minus -inf or divide by 0.
sdpa is three lines: scores = Q @ K^T / sqrt(d), A = masked_softmax(scores, mask), out = A @ V. Use np.swapaxes(K, -1, -2) so it works with any leading batch and head axes.

For sdpa_backward walk the graph in reverse: dV = A^T dout, dA = dout V^T, then the softmax step dS = A * (dA - rowsum(dA * A)), then undo the scale and the two matmuls: dQ = dS K / sqrt(d), dK = dS^T Q / sqrt(d). Masked entries have A = 0, so they get zero gradient for free.

Heads are a reshape, not a loop: (N, T, d) -> (N, T, h, d/h) -> transpose to (N, h, T, d/h). Merge is the inverse. Each head gets a contiguous block of d/h feature columns; sdpa then runs on all heads at once.

In MultiHeadAttention.backward the order is: dWo from the merged context, push dout through Wo, split into heads, sdpa_backward, merge, then dWq/dWk/dWv = x^T d(q/k/v) and dx is the SUM of the three paths back into x. Verify every weight and dx with finite differences.
